text:
</sub>  Bind precision evidence to the cohort configuration

When the precision fixtures use different prompt, inference, or other non-model settings from the real-PR cohort, this clause can still admit the recall claim because it binds only the category-list version, effective sweep configuration, and model identity to the claimed heads; AC9 merely requires the two precision arms to match each other. A low-noise precision result from configuration A can therefore validate recall measured under configuration B even though false-positive behavior is configuration-dependent. Require the precision evidence to match the cohort's full effective review configuration apart from the fixture target and sweep arm.
